DS3218 PRO is sold out, DS3235 availability conflicts, the HobbyKing battery showed one remaining and could not be re-fetched, TF-Luna has a lead time and the 40A ESC title conflicts with its 3-4S specification; obtain assured quotes before procurement.
Controller hardware remains an open requirement; the Pico 2 plus MPU-6050 entry is a low-cost reference, not a selection, and flight firmware is outside the current scope.
Height and horizontal-position sensing adequacy at 5 m outdoors (sunlight, ground reflectance, texture, downwash) is unverified; a barometric or redundant height source may be required.
Refine the gimbal load analysis (rotor inertia, net versus summed gyroscopic moment, required tilt rate) before choosing between DS3218 PRO and DS3235 classes.
Replace structure, bearing, leg, fastener, wiring and distribution allowances with CAD-derived cut lists and priced parts.
Temu, Taobao and AliExpress product data could not be retrieved; human-supplied quotes are needed to evaluate marketplace cost reductions.

C8 depends on MG996R adequacy; run a refined gimbal load analysis with signed net rotor angular momentum under bounded yaw-differential RPM, realistic rotor inertia, pivot mass balance and thrust-line offset, then choose MG996R, SER0063 (C9) or a 6 to 7.4 V servo rail.
Bunnings prices and stock are store-dependent and Core Electronics fastener packs show 1 to 3 units per length; confirm at purchase.
8 mm pivot pins for the 688ZZ bearings and the servo linkage hardware remain allowances until CAD defines them.
Replace the assumed eight M3 packs with a CAD-derived fastener schedule.
Range and failsafe test the installed ceramic-antenna ELRS Lite receiver before any free flight.
Define barometer shielding and port placement and fusion with the MTF-01 range sensor; quantify downwash and ground-effect bias.
The Skywalker is a fixed-wing ESC; measure command-to-RPM response on the test stand and compare with a multirotor-firmware ESC if thrust or yaw response is inadequate.
The selected XT90 listing states 40 A continuous; check against reserve pack current and measure connector temperature during endurance tests.
Recompute whole-vehicle mass, energy and current budgets with the selected configuration's listed masses and CAD-derived structure masses before a provisional selection is recorded.
